title: senna macranthera var. micans
intro: Senna macranthera var. micans, commonly known as smooth Alexandrian senna, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is a perennial legume that is traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of smooth Alexandrian senna include its ability to aid in digestion, relieve constipation, and help reduce fever. The plant's therapeutic actions include its laxative, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as anthraquinone glycosides, including sennosides A and B.
